items.question: Is Deja Kelly in the WNBA?
items.answer: The Dallas Wings announced on September 22, 2026, that they signed guard Deja Kelly to a developmental player contract. She wears No. 2. The Wings said she led the Charlotte Crown to the Upshot League title in its inaugural season and was named the Ann Meyers Drysdale MVP. She had gone undrafted, signed a training camp contract with the Las Vegas Aces in April 2025, and was waived before that season.

items.question: Where did Deja Kelly play college basketball?
items.answer: The Dallas Wings said Deja Kelly played four seasons at North Carolina, where she scored 1,858 points, then averaged 12.2 points, 4.3 rebounds, and 3.3 assists as a graduate student at Oregon in 2024-25. The WNBA draft page lists North Carolina as her previous school and Oregon as her college.
